title: fix(core): lower modifyAllRecords in the managed write clamp where the write guard refuses edit or delete
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZUqByp4kJMhCQDWZ2
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJHeo7w1wp7HQ5HRJRCx6FL)_
Fixes #30440

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：受管对象（better-auth / engine-owned / append-only）的权限视图里，显式的「修改全部记录」在写守卫拒绝编辑或删除时被降为「查看全部记录」，并保留对象仍开放的动作；未开放编辑的对象上「转移」也一并清掉（超级管理员之前在这些对象上被告知可以转移）。
- 为什么改：之前只要权限集写了 modifyAllRecords，`current_user.can()` 和控制台按钮就说可以编辑、删除、转移，但写守卫实际一律拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只改服务端返回的能力答案，不改任何写入的放行与拒绝；回滚即还原本 PR 的单个函数。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` 的 `clampManagedObjectWrites` 与新 helper `lowerModifyAllRecords`；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` 一致性表的 `CLAMPED` 与新行；测试块 `[#30440]`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts`，预期 55 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`clampManagedObjectWrites` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`) cleared `allowEdit` / `allowCreate` / `allowDelete` on an object in a guarded `managedBy` bucket that does not opt the verb in through `userActions`, but never touched `modifyAllRecords`, which the spec's `objectPermissionGrants` reads as edit, delete and transfer on its own. A permission set naming such an object with `{ modifyAllRecords: true }` therefore answered `current_user.can(object, 'edit' | 'delete' | 'transfer')` true while the write guard refused every one of those writes.

- New private helper `lowerModifyAllRecords(acc, kept)`: when the entry carries `modifyAllRecords: true` and a layer refuses at least one of edit / delete / transfer, the bit becomes `false`, `viewAllRecords` becomes `true` (the read it implies, so read is unchanged), and each verb `kept` names is carried over as its plain `allow*` bit.
- `clampManagedObjectWrites` calls it with `{ allowEdit: edit, allowDelete: delete, allowTransfer: edit }` from the object's `userActions` opt-ins.
- **Claim amendment 6658639729 (seat):** `clampManagedObjectWrites` also clears a plain `allowTransfer` on a guarded object that does not opt `edit` in. The super-user wildcard fold copies the transfer bit `modifyAllRecords` grants onto every entry it covers, so the shipped platform admin was served `can(object, 'transfer')` true on every such object while the guard refused the update. Measured on `c5800818`: an engine-owned object opting nothing in, wildcard `{ allowRead, viewAllRecords, modifyAllRecords }`, map entry `allowTransfer: true`, and `assertEngineOwnedWriteAllowed(…, 'update', user)` throws `PermissionDeniedError`. After the fix the same probe answers transfer `false`.
- **Same amendment, the agreement table** in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (can() over the served map vs `PermissionEvaluator.checkObjectPermission`, which does not model the guard): its `CLAMPED` set, the cells it forgives in the refuse direction on a guarded object, gains `allowTransfer`, and it gains a row `[#30440] explicit modifyAllRecords entries on guarded managed objects` (`sys_user` opting edit in, `sys_member` opting nothing in, private `sys_secret`).
- `clampExternalReadOnlyWrites` (#30370, PR #30416) now goes through the same helper with nothing kept; its behaviour is byte-identical (its existing tests are unchanged and green).

**The partial opt-in choice (dispatch scope item 2).** `objectPermissionGrants` answers edit as `read && (allowEdit || modifyAll)`, delete as `read && (allowDelete || modifyAll)` and transfer as `allowTransfer || modifyAll`, so a `false` beside `modifyAllRecords` takes nothing away: an entry cannot keep `modifyAllRecords` and refuse only delete. So:

| object opts in | `modifyAllRecords` | served `can()` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| nothing (`sys_automation_run`, `http_delivery`) | lowered to `viewAllRecords` | read only |
| `edit` only (`sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_api_key`) | lowered; `allowEdit` + `allowTransfer` kept | read, edit, transfer; no delete |
| `edit` and `delete` | kept | unchanged |

Transfer follows `edit` because an owner change is an update: the engine-owned guard maps it to the `edit` affordance, and #30416's external clamp already treats it the same way. What is lost when the bit is lowered on an `edit`-only object is record-level "all records" scope for edit, which only the server evaluator reads (unchanged here); the served map's consumers read the object-level verbs (`current_user.can`, `MePermissionsProvider`'s transfer check), and those keep edit and transfer.

## Tests

New block `[#30440] a guarded managed object grants no verb its write guard refuses, modifyAllRecords included` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (the existing harness file for this map), through `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` and the spec's real `objectPermissionGrants`:

- explicit `{ modifyAllRecords: true }` on an engine-owned object opting nothing in: no edit / delete / transfer, same read;
- the same on a `sys_user`-shaped object (edit opted in): edit and transfer kept, delete gone;
- an object opting edit and delete in keeps `modifyAllRecords`;
- CONTROL: the same entry on an unguarded object keeps every verb `modifyAllRecords` grants;
- a plain `allowTransfer` on an object not opting edit in answers no transfer; on `sys_user` (edit opted in) it stays;
- CONTROL: the super-user wildcard fold answers exactly as on `main` on every object except the folded transfer bit on the object opting nothing in, which now reads `false` (the fold copies granted bits, never `modifyAllRecords`).

plugin-security's agreement table: one new row (above) and `allowTransfer` in `CLAMPED`; 68/68.

## Acceptance notes

- The `allowTransfer` half was first handed back as out of scope (first commit `47fe789a` cleared it and red 13 rows of the agreement table; `5dd16ba3` took it out); the seat chose to take it here and amended the claim (6658639729); `04b5cbbe` puts it back with the table change.
- Observation, not filed: on the same measurement `apiOperations` for the engine-owned object lists `create` / `update` / `delete`. That annotation reads `enable.apiMethods` exposure, a different layer from the guard; noted only.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measured on main first (c5800818), probe deleted after use</summary>

```
PROBE map probe_engine_owned = {"modifyAllRecords":true,"allowEdit":false,"allowCreate":false,"allowDelete":false,…} · can: allowRead=true allowCreate=false allowEdit=true allowDelete=true allowTransfer=true
PROBE map sys_user_like = {"modifyAllRecords":true,"allowCreate":false,"allowDelete":false,…} · can: allowRead=true allowCreate=false allowEdit=true allowDelete=true allowTransfer=true
PROBE guard probe_engine_owned update: REFUSED PermissionDeniedError [Security] Access denied: 'probe_engine_owned' is engine-owned (managedBy:'engine-owned', …
PROBE guard probe_engine_owned delete: REFUSED PermissionDeniedError …
```

The same probe after the fix: `probe_engine_owned` can edit/delete/transfer = false/false/false, read true; `sys_user_like` edit/delete/transfer = true/false/true; the unguarded control unchanged.
</details>
